summary: Published a universal signed and notarized DMG from source commit 48f56627. It includes stalled-write watchdog termination with diagnostic details, safe decoding of unreadable DM-32UV and RT-950 tone values, UV-32 handshake retries, Android USB broken-pipe handling, and the cumulative 1.0.67 driver, UI, bridge, trace, printing, and write-progress changes. Artifact SHA-256: 3fd6068c5750adcb1d3a53928e41cddaab789394989d60ee9b76f321e334c47d. Apple notarization: ad8c3d81-e2f2-493a-a972-cb34f65952ea. The DMG launched from the mounted image; local/server/public hashes matched and the live manifest reports macOS 1.0.68.
title: macOS 1.0.68 published
